description.en:
Gives a character a Fighting Spirit with a jingle and a message. It stops the current BGM with a fade of _fade (CMND_SND_STOP) and opens the jingle _jingle; it waits until the BGM has stopped, waits _wait frames and waits for the jingle to load, then plays the jingle. After CMND_RESET_TALK_CHARA it fills the message placeholders (index _index), shows the message _event with CreateSpeech and applies the reward. It waits for the jingle to end and plays the BGM again with the same fade (CMND_SND_PLAY(hBGM, 1.0, _fade)). The character and the Fighting Spirit fill placeholder _index (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA and CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_ITEM).
If _atch is true, it gets the character's party handle, enables the Fighting Spirit (CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE), unlocks it for the change, calls CMND_ATTACH_AVATAR(_chr, _avt), then restores the lock flag it had, and locks it if _lock is true. If _atch is false, only the message is shown.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
Fade used to stop and restart the BGM (the presets pass 30).
Frames to wait after the BGM has stopped (the presets pass 30).
Event sound played during the message ("J_08" or "J_07" in the presets).
Placeholder index used in the message (the presets pass 0).
true to attach the Fighting Spirit, false to show only the message.
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.

examples.case: What RunAttachAvatar("para_cp0005", "ck0025") runs (real preset, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
